farm.accelerate_desc:
You pour the Growth Elixir over the soil.
*The crop ripens in a flash!*
farm.blessed_zone_active: 🍀 *Nature's blessing lingers here , next harvest doubled!*
farm.event_blessing_desc:
A warm energy flows through the soil.
*Nature smiles upon your fields today!*
farm.event_blessing_result_desc: Your next harvest in this zone will be doubled!
farm.event_crop_circles_desc:
Strange geometric patterns have appeared in your field overnight.
*Your crops seem to be growing faster...*
farm.event_crop_circles_result_desc: All crops in this zone have been accelerated! Growth time halved.
farm.event_merchant_bought_desc: You purchase an exotic seed from the merchant.
farm.event_merchant_desc:
"{merchant}" approaches your farm with a cart full of curiosities.

*"Fine goods from distant lands! What'll it be?"*
farm.event_merchant_leave_desc: "Another time, then!" The merchant packs up and continues down the road.
farm.event_merchant_no_money_desc: You can't afford the merchant's exotic seed.
farm.event_merchant_sell_desc: You sell your ready crops at a premium price!
farm.event_mysterious_seed_desc:
While harvesting, you discover an unusual seed pulsing with a faint light.
*It has been added to your inventory , plant it to see what grows!*
farm.event_pest_desc:
Pests are swarming your crops on **Plot #{plot}**!
*They'll eat through your harvest if you don't act!*
farm.event_pest_ignore_desc: You stand back and watch the pests swarm. Perhaps they will move on.
farm.event_pest_ignore_destroyed_desc: The pests devoured your crop. Nothing remains.
farm.event_pest_ignore_survive_desc: The pests move on without causing significant damage. Lucky!
farm.event_pest_pesticide_desc: The pests scatter! Your crops are safe.
farm.event_pest_win_desc: You fight off the pests! The crop is saved, though slightly damaged.
farm.fertilize_desc:
You sprinkle fertilizer on the soil.
*Growth accelerated by 30%!*
farm.harvest_all_partial: ⚠️ Your inventory filled up , some plots couldn't be harvested.
farm.harvest_blessed: ✨ **Blessed Harvest!** Yield doubled by nature's blessing!
farm.no_ready_plots: ❌ No plots are ready to harvest in this zone yet.
farm.inspect_hint: 💡 Want to speed up growth? Get **Fertilizer** (🧪) or a **Growth Elixir** (⚡) at the market.
farm.inspect_empty: No plots are active. Plant some seeds!
farm.inspect_mysterious: An unknown growth pulses with energy. What will it become?
farm.limit_reached: ❌ You've used all your farm actions for today (100 max).
farm.mutation_blood_tomato: 🍅 *Deep crimson, pulsing with an inner warmth...* **Blood Tomato!**
farm.mutation_cursed_pumpkin: 🎃 *A faint whispering emanates from within...* **Cursed Pumpkin!**
farm.mutation_generic: 🌟 *The crop has mutated into something extraordinary!*
farm.mutation_ghost_wheat: 🌾 *A translucent shimmer runs through the wheat...* **Ghost Wheat!**
farm.mutation_golden_potato: 🥔 *A warm golden glow emerges from the dirt...* **Golden Potato!**
farm.mutation_nova_fruit: ⭐ *A miniature star cradled in your hands!* **Nova Fruit!**
farm.no_land_desc:
You don't own this land!
Buy the **{deed}** at the `!shop`.
farm.no_seeds: ❌ You don't have any seeds in your inventory!
farm.planted_mysterious_desc:
You bury the glowing seed in the dark soil.
*What will emerge?*
farm.scarecrow_desc:
As you work nearby, the old scarecrow's button eye seems to blink...
*You find a small charm at its base.*
farm.secret_golden_carrot: 🥕 **GOLDEN CARROT!** In the pale light of dawn, you pull a carrot of pure gold from the soil!
farm.seedmaker_desc:
Process your harvest into seeds!
**1 fruit → 2-4 seeds**
farm.seedmaker_no_crops: ❌ You don't have any harvestable fruits to process!
farm.stats_empty: You haven't harvested any crops yet. Start farming!
farm.time_afternoon: ☀️ *The sun beats down on the fertile soil.*
farm.time_evening: 🌆 *Golden hour paints the farm in warm hues.*
farm.tip_1: 💧 Watering your crops before they mature can increase your yield!
farm.tip_2: 🧿 The scarecrow in the public fields seems alive. Try interacting with it.
farm.tip_3: 🌱 Planting mysterious seeds can yield surprising results!
farm.tip_4: 🧪 Fertilizer from the shop speeds up crop growth considerably.
farm.tip_5: 🌟 Each crop has a secret mutation. Keep farming to discover them all!
farm.tip_6: 🍀 High LUK increases your chances of rare harvest events.
farm.tip_7: 🧳 The Wandering Merchant appears randomly. Always be ready to trade!
farm.tip_8: 🥕 Try farming carrots in the Vegetable Patch at dawn. You might find something special.
farm.water_desc:
You sprinkle fresh water on the crop.
*Yield slightly improved.*
farm.zone_greenhouse_desc: Warmth envelops you as you step inside. Steam fogs the glass panels. Strange and exotic plants thrive in the tropical air.
farm.zone_orchard_desc: The floating islands of the orchard drift among the clouds. Ancient trees bear fruit that glows with otherworldly light. The air hums with magic.
farm.zone_public_desc: The communal fields stretch before you, alive with the chatter of passing villagers. The soil here is well-trodden but fertile.
farm.zone_veggie_desc: Your private patch, tucked behind the old mill. Rich, dark soil promises bountiful harvests. A scarecrow stands watch at the edge.
farm.event_buried_desc: Your hoe scrapes against something hard in the ground. A metal object — buried deep, but a magnet could pull it out...
farm.event_buried_win_desc: The magnet yanks the buried object out of the earth — ore clings to it in clumps!
farm.event_buried_no_magnet_desc: You reach into your bag... you don't have that magnet with you. The ground keeps its secret.
farm.event_buried_leave_desc: You walk away. Some hoards are better left in the dirt.
